body:
# Melinda Manning

# Melinda Manning (D)

# Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2025/12/manning.jpg)

- Her **[FB intro](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/0210aa32-1a5d-4c72-9d87-ece628c9fc36/CHCCS-Melinda-Manning-FB-profile.png)** reads: “Nasty woman who likes civility, dismantling the patriarchy, yoga, real books, tea, and buying local.”
- **[Vowed to](https://indyweek.com/news/chapel-hill-carrboro-city-schools-board-melinda-manning/?fbclid=IwY2xjawO3oEtleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZBAyMjIwMzkxNzg4MjAwODkyAAEeAwkhaOugtgW6y60uBxKNxiiwAqSc2bsHF_DCciqJSZhb3KHtRaUGOYjitAs_aem_ogltcqQuYsVJZ5pHqXZ7Zw)** protect illegal alien students and families from ICE, pointing to protocols used in Los Angeles such as locking down schools if ICE tries to come in.
- Prolific social media posts attacking Trump, including **[calling him a racist](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/48404b50-b5d6-462f-aaaf-108aebd1442d/CHCCS-Melinda-Manning-Trump-racist.png)**.
- Posted on FB that she would aid and abet abortion

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/manning1.png)
